evidence_quote: Objective: To identify plasma protein differences between type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) patients with and without metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD), and to evaluate the diagnostic potential of X-prolyl aminopeptidase 3 (XPNPEP3) for identifying MASLD in T2DM patients.
rationale: The study evaluates a plasma biomarker for liver disease in patients with diabetes. The abstract does not address brain or neural mechanisms, cognition, neural injury, or neurological disease diagnosis or treatment.
